description: AC-11.1 / AC-11.2 connected-accounts UI contract. Social connections use a credential store separate from app sign-in, stream destinations, and the contribution service. Each connection row shows provider, capabilities, status, and revoke.
rule: Connected accounts only read and write the social_connections plane. Tokens never move across planes.
capabilities_source: provider.use_cases union provider.oauth_scopes_least_privilege from D8 registry
rules: Screen lists connections from the social_connections credential plane only
Revoke deletes the encrypted token for that connection_id and removes the row
Never display access_token, refresh_token, or passphrase material
Unverified providers cannot be connected for publishing
Publish still requires publish-approval.v0 (AC-11.6) and runtime_enabled for live send
notes: OM-036 ships the contract, CredentialStoreRegistry, ConnectedAccountsService, and app screen
Live OAuth authorization code flow remains blocked until owner credentials exist
